'''Rotclaw''' was a particularly large and dangerous bloodclaw [[mouf]] that lived in a group of moufs on the [[Rryatt Trail#High Grounds|High Grounds]] of the [[Rryatt Trail]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].

==Behind the scenes==
Rotclaw was a creature in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the second expansion for [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. It could be found on the High Grounds level of the Rryatt Trail. It was a level 56 [[:w:c:swg:Elite|Gold Chevron elite]], which meant that it was much stronger and tougher than normal moufs and even posed a threat to players with higher levels. It was not involved in any quest, but the players had to cross the area where Rotclaw and a group of other moufs could be found in order to reach the next level of the Rryatt trail.
